"import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from openpyxl import Workbook

# Read the CSV file
parts_data = defaultdict(lambda: {"desc": "", "unit": "", "qty_total": 0})

with open("eng_bom_04.csv", "r", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        part_no = row["part_no"]
        desc = row["desc"]
        unit = row["unit"]
        qty = row["qty"]
        # Parse qty - handle potential floats/ints
        try:
            qty_val = float(qty) if qty else 0
        except ValueError:
            qty_val = 0
        # Aggregate
        if part_no not in parts_data or parts_data[part_no]["desc"] == "":
            parts_data[part_no]["desc"] = desc
            parts_data[part_no]["unit"] = unit
        parts_data[part_no]["qty_total"] += qty_val

# Sort part numbers ascending (string sort)
sorted_parts = sorted(parts_data.keys())

# Create workbook
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "BOM"

# Write header
header = ["part_no", "desc", "qty_total", "unit"]
ws.append(header)

# Write data rows
for part_no in sorted_parts:
    data = parts_data[part_no]
    qty_rounded = round(data["qty_total"])
    ws.append([part_no, data["desc"], qty_rounded, data["unit"]])

# Save the workbook
wb.save("output.xlsx")"
